children: That's how much gold the Dutch central bank said it moved from North America to London, citing "increasing geopolitical unrest."
Bullion held by the U.K.'s central bank is "the world's most easily tradable gold and will therefore be the most readily available for DNB in a crisis situation," the Dutch central bank said.
